lines.l: Black girl, don't lie to me
Tell me where did you sleep, did you sleep last night?
In the pines, in the pines
Well, the sun never shined
And I shivered, I shivered the whole night through
Her husband, well, he was a railroad man
From the poor side of town
His head was stuck in the drive as we know
But his body, his body was never found
My girl, my black girl
Tell me where, where will you go?
I'm walking down a lonely road
Where the cold, where the cold wind blows
In the pines, in the pines
Where the sun never shines
And I shiver, I shiver the whole night through
Black girl, my girl, tell me where did you sleep, where did you sleep last night
Black girl
You can leave
On me brother
